 docs_src async_tests app_a_py310 test_main 
 
```python
import pytest
from httpx import ASGITransport, AsyncClient

from .main import app


@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_root():
    async with AsyncClient(
        transport=ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://test"
    ) as ac:
        response = await ac.get("/")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json() == {"message": "Tomato"}
```

 SQLModel point app database overriding session dependency 
 
```python
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlmodel import Session, SQLModel, create_engine
from sqlmodel.pool import StaticPool

from .main import app, get_session


@pytest.fixture(name="session")
def session_fixture():
    engine = create_engine(
        "sqlite://", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}, poolclass=StaticPool
    )
    SQLModel.metadata.create_all(engine)
    with Session(engine) as session:
        yield session


@pytest.fixture(name="client")
def client_fixture(session: Session):
    def get_session_override():
        return session

    app.dependency_overrides[get_session] = get_session_override
    client = TestClient(app)
    yield client
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()


def test_create_hero(client: TestClient):
    response = client.post("/heroes/", json={"name": "Deadpond", "secret_name": "Dive Wilson"})
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json()["name"] == "Deadpond"
```
